theorem: For every finite connected occupied set C in either frozen FCC or HCP native 12-contact world and every connected component Omega of the unoccupied graph, F(C) intersect Omega is connected under native 12-contact.

proof_core.interface_complex: K_Omega is the finite native cell interface between the Omega-side cell union and the union of all other native cells in the one-point compactified close-packed cellulation.
proof_core.frontier_component_cycle: For every native frontier component Gamma, sum mod 2 all interface 2-faces whose Omega-side site lies in Gamma. Every native dual edge is dual to a Delaunay triangle, so binary cut incidence is 0 or 2. When two distinct Omega endpoints occur they are joined by a triangle edge and hence are native 12-contact neighbors in the same Gamma. Therefore the face sum is a nonzero 2-cycle.
proof_core.independence: Distinct frontier components have disjoint interface-face support. Since K_Omega is 2-dimensional, there are no 3-cell boundaries, so these nonzero 2-cycles are linearly independent in H_2(K_Omega;F2).
proof_core.nonempty_boundary: Every complement component of a nonempty finite occupied set touches C in the connected native world, so the frontier slice is nonempty. Hence its number of components is exactly 1.

c4_regression.octa_bad_type: opposite-pair point pinch or color complement
